subject: Home is where the heart is...
author: SUFFUR
body:
And I was brought up there, I like so much about it that I should "just live there, then" and in my mind I do. But yes I have a British Passport, and Live more in the UK now, but Singapore is where my heart is.

Thankfully (not because it's bad, but because of who I am) not a Singaporean, can't speak Chinese very well, let alone English, and I have issues reading it because of the dyslexia, and National Service is something I would have done well when I was 18, but then I would have been part of some sort of Military system, which I am not keen, being a Pacifist, like the other one, but will use a fist if, my patience level  drops and probably win due to being able to take the punishment, though I have lost because it got that far in the first place. And I don't think I have ever started, but have always finshed, even by turning the other cheek, damn that one hurt, but I was worth it for a peace of mind. 

But my Location will always Singapore on my 'Flea Sixty', for you cheeky Xenophobes out there!

And I'm more international than a Brit, I have had the oppertunity to live across most of the world, seeing many different types of cultures, relgions, traditions and life styles, one of the reasons I am most understanding about most stuff, when people sound rude ( did have another word but I could not for the life of me know how to spell it, but it's replacement, may seem more harsh in others eyes but it will do), but are really trying to be funny and just express themselves. I have a high tolerance level for a lot of things, but I can be human and react like an idiot at any time, especially if my pain goes up highier than expected, but most of the time i'm the giant silent guy sitting in the corner of the kitchen, watching the people go by, but if I find someone cool to talk to I listen, but I can also talk your ear off, and none of it will make sense the next day, but it was fun.

And I don't think I ever made a secret of it anyway, and a lot of people do pick a location to suit their GamerTag and personality that goes with that tag.

People think it's me that want people to SUFFUR, when it's the other way round, I SUFFUR for myself, and take others, when I can, and at small charge of the price of a steak, a nice bottle of red wine, and some comfortable, safe surroundings, i'm empathic (not sure of the spelling and I'm sure I wrote this before, prizes to anyone who finds it)sometimes, and see trouble brewing way before it stihs the fan, a nice survival technique, now I think I spelt that 1 right, sa'weat, now what was the point of your question?

Oh and you should see me walk, it's very entertaining, and if I'm running you better be on fire, and hanging from a cliff, less than a 100 meters away, or you're buggered, as that is as far as I can run, can do it quite quickly too, but we will both probably need an ambulance after I save your sorry ssa!

And again curious to why you are curious, of Master of Revenge🙄

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

PS just read this and I'm not that great, but it's what I try and think and do. But I am a Lazy so-and-so, because I like to get fired up, ...no fire, can't be bothered to, a bad trait that I'm trying to work on.
